race.comment: DUE CALZINI (3) returned from a 39-day let-up with a courageous win in open company over the mile at Canberra last start. Goes up 2.5kgs today but drops sharply in grade. Placed over 2100m at Wyong last prep so today's journey at provincial level is not a hindrance. Big chance to go back-to-back. VALENTIAGO (4) made it three minor placings from as many runs this prep when a distant third over this course and distance last time out. Fitter for that run and should be close to peak fitness at this stage of the campaign. FALCON LAIR (1) is a handy stayer who was tested in stakes races in Brisbane during the Winter. Good effort last start when second-up, beaten just over a length over 1900m at Newcastle. Perfectly placed up to 2000m at the third run back. SERPICO (6) ground home well for third in a longer race at Wyong last time, a welcomed return to form. At his best can mix it with these. CANNY QUEEN (2) ran on well behind DUE CALZINI over a mile last start but is a risk at this trip.
